forum.title: No ST humidity sensors ?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi Andrew,

short answer: Yes.

As the saying goes: there have been changes in the market that have made it very difficult to continue production or to follow a future roadmap. I am very sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused, and I ask for your understanding.

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
The [HTS221](https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/hts221.html) is marked as Obsolete, and the only suggested alternative is [SHT40-AD1B](https://www.st.com/en/partner-products-and-services/sht40-ad1b.html) - a 3rd-party device.

Has ST abandoned this product area?
